verdict.rationale: Canva is a design editor, so responsive frame behavior is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack never mentions auto layout, constraints, or layout grids. The only related material is about generating resized copies of a design in new dimensions (canva-docs-16, canva-docs-35). That is a one-off output operation, not frames that flex responsively, so it is an adjacent feature and earns no credit.

support.subject: As a designer, frames can behave responsively — auto layout, constraints, and grids resize designs the way real UIs flex
